Text A. I enjoy painting landscapes. New members can try three colors before buying any materials. Our teacher provides brushes and paper. We meet on Friday afternoons. You can display a finished picture in the hall.

Text B. We like playing chess and other board games. Beginners learn with a partner. We meet at lunchtime, so you needn’t stay after school. Bring a board if you have one. We have extra sets to share.

Text C. We want to make and fly our own kites. An adult helps with the design. We meet on Saturday mornings. If it rains, we work indoors. Bring an old magazine for colorful paper.
